purpose: The Windows APIs whose documented purpose is an anti-analysis technique, beyond the ones the behaviour catalogue and the API-to-ATT&CK map already list; read with them by maljan.analysis.ghidra_passes.anti_analysis_apis to decide which of Ghidra's API matches the triage pack states.

techniques.name: Debugger Evasion
techniques.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise, technique T1622 Debugger Evasion, description: "may involve Native API function calls such as IsDebuggerPresent() and NtQueryInformationProcess()" and "flooding debug logs with meaningless data via messages produced by looping Native API function calls such as OutputDebugStringW()"
